## Part 2 — Configuration Architecture

| Dimension | What it controls | Levels | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|---|
| Depth | Research thoroughness (interviews, audit rigor) | Light (3 stakeholder, 0 customer) / Standard (6 + 5) / Deep (10 + 10) | Deep blocked on Sprint pace |
| Breadth | Brand-system scope | Verbal-only / Verbal + Visual direction / Full system (verbal + visual + naming) | Naming requires Breadth ≥ Verbal + Visual |
| Pace | Calendar length | Sprint (2 wk) / Standard (6 wk) / Deep (10 wk) | Sprint blocks Deep depth; Sprint blocks Full system |
| Format | Delivery artifacts | PDF guide only / PDF + rollout deck / PDF + deck + handoff brief | Handoff brief requires Breadth ≥ Verbal + Visual |
| Support | Revisions + access | 1 round, email 48hr / 2 rounds, Slack 24hr / Unlimited + weekly office hours | Unlimited blocked on Sprint pace |
| Post-delivery | Advisory after final | None / 30-day async / 90-day embedded | 90-day requires Support = Unlimited |
| Add-ons | Discrete modules | Naming / Customer research deep-dive / Internal rollout facilitation / Competitive teardown refresh | Naming requires Breadth ≥ Verbal + Visual |

**Invalid combinations the configurator must block**
- Sprint pace + Deep depth
- Sprint pace + Full system breadth
- Sprint pace + Unlimited revisions
- Naming add-on without Visual direction
- Handoff brief format without Visual direction
- 90-day embedded post-delivery without Unlimited support
- Customer research deep-dive at Light depth (contradiction)

## Part 3 — Three Tiers + Build-Your-Own

### Tier 1 — Positioning Sprint (Lite)

- **Configuration:** Depth Light · Breadth Verbal-only · Pace Sprint (2 wk) · Format PDF only · Support 1 round, email 48hr · Post-delivery None
- **Positioning line:** For founders who need a sharp positioning statement and messaging pillars fast — before a pitch, launch, or site rewrite.
- **Pricing logic:** **$6,500.** ~40% of flagship; anchored against the cost of launching with weak positioning (one bad quarter of conversion). Entry point that proves the method.

### Tier 2 — Brand Guide (Core / Flagship) — $15,000

- **Configuration:** Depth Standard · Breadth Verbal + Visual direction · Pace Standard (6 wk) · Format PDF + rollout deck · Support 2 rounds, Slack 24hr · Post-delivery 30-day async
- **Positioning line:** For funded startups and growing companies who need a complete brand foundation their team and vendors can execute against.
- **Pricing logic:** **$15,000** (your current price, preserved as flagship anchor). Sits well below boutique-agency equivalents ($25–50K) while delivering senior-strategist-only engagement.

### Tier 3 — Brand System + Embed (Premium)

- **Configuration:** Depth Deep · Breadth Full system (incl. Naming) · Pace Deep (10 wk) · Format PDF + deck + handoff brief · Support Unlimited + weekly office hours · Post-delivery 90-day embedded
- **Positioning line:** For companies at an inflection point (rebrand, Series B, category pivot) who need naming, deep research, and a strategist embedded through rollout.
- **Pricing logic:** **$32,000.** Priced below the sum-of-parts (standalone naming alone runs $8–15K; 90-day fractional strategy advisory runs $4–6K/mo). Below mid-tier consultancy retainers (~$45K) while being senior-led end-to-end.

### Build-Your-Own Framework

**Base:** $6,500 (Positioning Sprint config)

**Per-dimension upgrade pricing:**
- Depth: Light → Standard **+$3,000** · Standard → Deep **+$5,000**
- Breadth: Verbal → +Visual **+$2,500** · +Visual → Full system (naming) **+$6,000**
- Pace: Sprint → Standard **+$1,500** · Standard → Deep **+$3,000**
- Format: PDF only → +Rollout deck **+$1,500** · +Handoff brief **+$2,000**
- Support: 1 round → 2 rounds + Slack **+$1,500** · 2 rounds → Unlimited + office hours **+$3,500**
- Post-delivery: None → 30-day async **+$2,000** · 30-day → 90-day embedded **+$5,000**

**Add-ons (à la carte):**
- Customer research deep-dive (10 interviews + synthesis): **+$4,000**
- Internal rollout facilitation (2 workshops): **+$3,500**
- Competitive teardown refresh (6-month post): **+$2,500**

**Floor:** $6,500 (below this, scope is too thin to produce strategic output)
**Ceiling:** $28,000 — above this, auto-route to Premium flagship or custom quote

**Configurator-enforced dependencies:** all invalid combinations listed in Part 2.

**Flagship-protection check:**
- BYO sum to reach **Core config:** $6,500 + 3,000 + 2,500 + 1,500 + 1,500 + 1,500 + 2,000 = **$18,000** → Core at $15K wins by $3K ✓
- BYO sum to reach **Premium config:** $6,500 + 8,000 + 8,500 + 3,000 + 3,500 + 5,000 + 5,000 = **$39,500** → Premium at $32K wins by $7.5K ✓

Flagships remain the rational discount.

## Part 3 — Three Tiers + Build-Your-Own

### Tier 1 — **Blueprint** (Lite)

- **Configuration:** Custom-programmed depth · Training-only breadth · Monthly pace · Async written format · 48h support · Programming-only session delivery · Self-report accountability
- **Positioning:** For self-directed clients who want a real custom program and a coach on standby — not hand-holding.
- **Pricing logic:** `+$A/mo`. Anchored ~30–40% of flagship; priced above template-app competitors (~$50–100/mo) because programming is actually custom, but below full coaching.

### Tier 2 — **Coaching** *(flagship)* (Core)

- **Configuration:** Fully-individualized depth · Training + Nutrition breadth · Biweekly pace · Async video+voice format · 24h support · Form-check video review · Weekly check-in form
- **Positioning:** For clients serious about results who want a coach reviewing their work, adjusting the plan, and answering questions all week.
- **Pricing logic:** `+$B/mo`. Flagship anchor; priced at the market rate for premium online coaching in the niche. BYO-equivalent configuration must sum **above** this.

### Tier 3 — **Signature** (Premium)

- **Configuration:** Fully-individualized depth · Full lifestyle breadth · Weekly pace · Live-call format · Same-day priority support · Live-coached sessions (2/mo) · Daily habit tracking · Peaking block included
- **Positioning:** For clients with a deadline, a stage, or a performance target — maximum access, maximum tailoring, coach in the room.
- **Pricing logic:** `+$C/mo`. Priced below an in-person personal trainer's monthly spend (4 sessions/mo in-person often runs `+$D`), making it the rational choice for high-touch remote clients.

### Build-Your-Own Framework

**Base:** `+$A/mo` (Blueprint configuration)

**Per-dimension upgrade pricing (monthly deltas):**
- Depth: Custom → Fully-individualized: `+$d1`
- Breadth: +Nutrition: `+$d2` · +Lifestyle: `+$d3`
- Pace: Monthly → Biweekly: `+$d4` · Biweekly → Weekly: `+$d5`
- Format: Async written → Video+voice: `+$d6` · → Live call: `+$d7`
- Support: 48h → 24h: `+$d8` · → Same-day: `+$d9`
- Session delivery: +Form-check: `+$d10` · +Live-coached (per session/mo): `+$d11`
- Accountability: +Weekly check-in form: `+$d12` · +Daily tracking: `+$d13`
- Add-ons: Deload `+$d14` · Peaking `+$d15` · Travel protocol `+$d16` · Event prep `+$d17`

**Floor:** `+$A/mo` — below this, send to a self-serve template product.

**Ceiling:** If BYO configuration exceeds ~90% of Signature's price **or** includes 2+ Premium-tier dimensions (Live-coached, Same-day, Daily tracking, Weekly pace + Fully-individualized), auto-route to Signature or custom-quote.

**Configurator must enforce:**
- All invalid combinations from Part 2
- Intake call required when Depth = Fully-individualized (bundle its cost into Depth upgrade)
- Live-coached sessions priced per-session/month, not flat
- Nutrition depth sub-selector appears only when Breadth includes Nutrition

**Flagship-protection rule:** The BYO sum to replicate Coaching's exact configuration must land ~15–20% above `+$B` (flagship price). Same for Signature vs. its BYO equivalent. If pricing deltas don't produce this gap, raise per-dimension deltas — do not lower flagship. Flagships must remain the rational discount.

This is out of scope for me.

**Why:** You're describing a pure SaaS product, not a service. SaaS is already modular — your "atoms" are features, your "configuration" is seats × plan, and your tiers already exist (Free / Pro / Enterprise). The Intelligent Clay skill decomposes *service* delivery (consulting, coaching, agency work, done-for-you) into configurable packages. Applying it to feature-based software would produce a worse version of what pricing-page and packaging frameworks already do well.

**What you likely want instead:**

- **Feature packaging / value-metric pricing** — frameworks from Patrick Campbell (ProfitWell), Kyle Poyar (OpenView), or *Monetizing Innovation* (Ramanujam & Tacke). These address: which features gate which tier, what the value metric is (seats vs. projects vs. usage), and how to structure Enterprise.
- **PLG expansion mechanics** — if the question is really "how do I get more revenue per account," look at usage-based add-ons, power-user features, and workspace/org-level upgrades.
- **Enterprise unbundling** — if "Custom" is a black box, the real work is defining the 3–5 Enterprise SKUs or add-on modules (SSO, audit logs, advanced permissions, dedicated support, SLA).

**One case where I *could* help:** if you also sell **implementation, onboarding, migration, training, or customer success** as a paid service alongside the software, I can modularize *that* portion into tiers + build-your-own. Hybrid offerings are in scope — but only the service side.

Want to redirect? Tell me either:
1. Which packaging/pricing question you're actually trying to answer (I'll point you to the right framework), or

This is out of scope for me.

Intelligent Clay productizes **services** — turning time, expertise, and process into configurable tiers. You're selling a **physical product**, which is already modular in a different sense: it has SKUs, variants, and bundles.

The structural logic you want isn't tiers + BYO atoms — it's:

- **Variant architecture** (leather type, thread color, stitching, monogram, card slots, size)
- **SKU vs. made-to-order split** (what's inventoried vs. configured-to-order)
- **Bundle logic** (wallet + cardholder + keychain sets)
- **Price laddering** across materials (standard veg-tan → shell cordovan)

If any of these is true, I *can* help:

1. **You also offer a service** around the wallets — custom commissions, repair-for-life, corporate gifting with onboarding, leather-care workshops, bespoke design consultations. That service portion is productizable.
2. **You want to launch a "design-your-own" configurator** on your site — that's a variant/SKU problem, better served by a product-configuration framework (Shopify's product options, a tool like Kickflip, or a bundle-builder skill).
3. **You're moving into teaching** — courses, patterns, kits, 1-on-1 leatherworking mentorship. That's a service and I can productize it.

Which (if any) describes what you're actually trying to do? If it's just "sell more wallets with more options," you want a variant/merchandising framework, not this one.

*Assuming a mid-market B2B SaaS where the $99/mo product is the recurring value and the $2,500 onboarding exists to de-risk enterprise rollout; will re-anchor with sharper figures once you name the vertical (e.g., HR tech, fintech ops, revenue analytics).*

**Hybrid-offering note:** The $99/mo SaaS is one fixed atom — not decomposed. Only the $2,500 implementation service is clay.

## Part 2 — Configuration Architecture

| Dimension | What it controls | Levels | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Depth** | How deeply the skill is tuned to the user's domain | Generic / Vertical pack / Custom-tuned fork | Custom-tuned requires private repo access |
| **Breadth** | How many offerings / verticals covered | Single offering / Single vertical / Multi-vertical org | Multi-vertical requires team-shared memory |
| **Support** | Human help attached | Self-serve / Async review / Live co-production / Dedicated partner | Live co-production requires scheduled time blocks |
| **Memory** | Persistence + cross-run learning | None / Local claude-mem / Team-shared / Org-wide w/ benchmarks | Org-wide requires private hosting |
| **Anchor Data** | Pricing benchmark quality the skill can cite | Generic (tokens only) / Sub-niche norms / Your competitive set | Competitive set requires intake + research block |
| **Branding** | Attribution & vocabulary | OSS attribution / Co-branded / White-label | White-label blocks public PRs back to OSS repo |
| **Iteration Loop** *(domain-specific)* | How the skill improves over time | Manual updates / Public GHA / Managed GHA on private fork | Managed GHA requires private fork + support ≥ async |
| **Configurator Output** *(domain-specific)* | What downstream tool receives the blueprint | Markdown only / JSON+YAML / Target-tool-native (Typeform/Webflow/etc.) | Target-native requires naming the tool at intake |

**Invalid combinations the configurator must block:**
- White-label + public GHA iteration (leaks branding)
- Custom-tuned fork + Self-serve support (no feedback loop to tune against)
- Org-wide memory + OSS attribution only (enterprise needs private hosting)
- Competitive-set anchor data + Generic depth (benchmark data wasted without vertical tuning)
- Dedicated partner + Single offering (over-scoped; route down)
- Target-tool-native configurator without naming the tool
